SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. B-REGI-141. Section D 6/02 Date January 9 /35）
REPORT
Subject (in full) Arrest by the Manila Police of Philippine and Chinese Commu-
nists on board a Soviet ship.
Made by... F.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by... （签名）
With reference to the copy of endorsement of D.C. ( Spe-
cial Branch) on the attached translation of extract from French Po-
lice Daily Intelligence report dated December 22, 1934, on the sub-
ject of arrest by the Manila Police of 23 Philippine and Chinese
communists on board the Soviet ship " Ordjonikidze", I have to
state that the local American Consulate-General has no official in-
formation regarding this matter.
It has been learned, however, from an official of the U.S.
Consulate-General, who happened to be in Manila at the time of the
arrests, that on December 22, 1934 the Soviet freighter" Ordjonikidze"
made an emergency call at that port ostensibly to obtain victuals.
The ship was admitted on a promise that none of the crew would be
given shore leave and no unauthorised persons would be allowed aboard.
Certain precautions were taken by the Manila Police to enforce these
restrictions, but despite same most of the crew were found to have
landed. The police then searched the ship and found that 23 Philip-
pino and Chinese residents of Manila had boarded without proper
authority. Most of them were known to the police and they were there-
fore arrested on suspicion of propagating communism.
No further information is available locally on the subject
in question.
A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.
Deputy Commissioner.
Special Branch
（签名）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
（印：上海公共租界工部局档案号 B-REGI-141。D 组 6/02 日期 1935年1月9日）
报告
事由（全称）马尼拉警方在苏联船只上逮捕菲律宾及中国共产党人。
呈报人……F.S.I. 普罗科菲耶夫 转呈人……（签名）
关于随附的1934年12月22日法国警察每日情报报告摘译件上警务处副处长（特别支部）的批注副本，涉及马尼拉警方在苏联船只“奥尔忠尼启则”号（Ordjonikidze）上逮捕23名菲律宾和中国共产党人一事，本人须声明，本地美国总领事馆对此事并无官方情报。
然而，据当时恰在马尼拉的一位美国总领事馆官员获悉，1934年12月22日，苏联货轮“奥尔忠尼启则”号紧急停靠该港，表面理由是获取食物补给。该船获准进港的条件是承诺船员不得上岸休假，且不允许未经授权的人员登船。马尼拉警方采取了一定预防措施以执行这些限制，但尽管如此，大部分船员仍被发现已登陆。随后警方搜查了该船，发现23名居住在马尼拉的菲律宾人和中国人未经适当授权登船。这些人大多为警方所熟知，因此因涉嫌宣传共产主义而被捕。
本地暂无关于上述事项的进一步情报。
A. 普罗科菲耶夫
副警务处长。
特别支部
（签名）

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, DECEMBER 22, 1931

REDS ARRESTED IN
MANILA
Captain of Soviet Vessel
Protests

Manila, Dec. 21.
Protests were lodged to-day with
the American and Philippine Govern-
ments by M. Mushoff, captain of the
Soviet freighter Ordjonikidze, against
action taken by the Philippine Con-
stabulary in boarding his vessel and
arresting 23 Manila residents.
Complaint was also made against
the step taken by the police in forcing
all Russians to return to the ship.
The authorities, when interviewed,
declared that the arrested men were
Filipino and Chinese communists
financed from Moscow. They would
be prosecuted, if possible, for Com-
munist activities.—Reuter.

《字林西报》，1931年12月22日

马尼拉逮捕赤色分子
苏联船只船长提出抗议

马尼拉，12月21日电。
苏联货轮“奥尔忠尼启则”号船长穆肖夫（M. Mushoff）今日向美国和菲律宾政府提出抗议，反对菲律宾保安队登上其船只并逮捕23名马尼拉居民的行动。
他还对警方强迫所有俄罗斯人返回船上的举措提出投诉。
当局在接受采访时宣称，被捕者是受莫斯科资助的菲律宾和中国共产党人。如有可能，他们将因共产主义活动受到起诉。——路透社。

pages.en:
Translation of extract from French Police Daily
Intelligence Report dated December 22, 1934.

Parag. 1. Arrest by the Manila Police of Philippino
and Chinese Communists on board a Soviet
ship.

The Manila Police arrested on board the Soviet
ship "Odjonikidze" 23 residents of Manila and at the
same time escorted back to that ship some Russians
who had disembarked from the same vessel
in that Port. The Manila authorities declared
that the persons arrested were Philippino and Chinese
communists who were financially supported by Moscow.
They will be prosecuted for communist activities.

Remark of D.C. (Special Branch)
" S. 2. For inquiry and report. The U.S.Consulate
may have some information."

D.S. Boropis.
Jan 31/35.
pages.zh:
1934年12月22日法国警察每日情报报告摘译件。

第1段。马尼拉警方在苏联船只上逮捕菲律宾及中国共产党人。

马尼拉警方在苏联船只“奥尔忠尼启则”号（Odjonikidze）上逮捕了23名马尼拉居民，同时将一些从该船在该港口下船的俄罗斯人护送回该船。马尼拉当局宣称，被捕者是受莫斯科资助的菲律宾和中国共产党人。他们将因共产主义活动受到起诉。

警务处副处长（特别支部）批注
“S. 2. 予以查询并报告。美国总领事馆可能掌握一些情报。”

D.S. 博罗皮斯（Boropis）。
1935年1月31日。
